note: Authoritative inventory of every environment variable the code reads. Values live in Doppler (logloads project) and Vercel; never commit real values. `status` reflects repo truth and must be provider-verified before cutover.

provider_verification.scope: Vercel Production variable names/targets, Supabase project and migration state, private media bucket, Anthropic credential-review readiness, Resend domain status, and code-derived activation gates
provider_verification.warning: Secret values remain intentionally unreadable. A variable listed as present is provider-verified by name and target, not copied into this document.

forbidden_cloudinary_configuration.rule: Every CLOUDINARY_* and LOGLOADS_CLOUDINARY_* variable remains unset in LogLoads environments. Supabase Storage is the only production private-media provider.
forbidden_cloudinary_configuration.why: Driver credential and trip-proof media must remain inside LogLoads-owned infrastructure. Known foreign tenants are also denied in code, without publishing their identifiers here.
